paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role in Residential Finance at Columbia. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it is hands-on finance for a large, real operation: a large housing and parking portfolio, where accurate reconciliations and clear variance reporting matter every month.

At Thomson Reuters I handled cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows, ran reconciliation that reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting, and supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. At Lenovo I ran variance and trend analysis on budget reallocation and owned the mapping and QA for reporting dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week.

That lines up with the reconciliations, month-end close, budget tracking and reporting tools the role describes. Student billing and the regulatory filings would be new to me, and I'd plan to learn them quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Financial Analyst role in Columbia's Residential Finance team. At Thomson Reuters I ran reconciliation and cash flow analysis and supported month-end close, and at Lenovo I did budget variance analysis and dashboard QA. I'd love to hear how the team runs its monthly reporting. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
